read.en: Corning slipped 0.4% on Oct 20 to $132.26 after a low of $127.56. It is below all its averages: the falling 5-day ($135.3), 10-day ($144.5) and 30-day ($152.4), the rising 200-day ($154.1) and the falling 100-day ($165.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing slightly; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($157.51), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: 康宁 10月20日下跌 0.4%，收于 $132.26，盘中低点 $127.56。股价位于所有均线下方：下行的 5 日（$135.3）、10 日（$144.5）和 30 日（$152.4），上行的 200 日（$154.1）及下行的 100 日均线（$165.9）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图略有收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$157.51），RSI 为 36。

read.en: The low broke the $130 Jul 30 support intraday, but the close recovered above it while staying under the $132.75 Oct 15 low. Resistance is $132.75, then $135.3 (5-day average) and $141.6 (Aug 24 low). Support is $130, then $127.6 (Oct 20 low) and $122.6 (Jul 29 low). A close below $127.6 would open $122.6; a close above $135.3 would target $141.6.
read.zh: 盘中低点跌破 $130 的 7月30日支撑，但收盘回到其上方，但仍收在 $132.75 的 10月15日低点下方。阻力为 $132.75，其次 $135.3（5 日均线）和 $141.6（8月24日低点）。支撑为 $130，其次 $127.6（10月20日低点）和 $122.6（7月29日低点）。若收盘跌破 $127.6，下一目标看 $122.6；若收盘站上 $135.3，下一目标看 $141.6。

s.en: Jul 30 low, held on the close
